extract: The Cape of Stranglethorn is the southern part of Stranglethorn Vale, designated as the piece of land south of the area around the Gurubashi Arena. Booty Bay, located to the southwest, is a major city run by goblin pirates - many profession trainers are located here, as well as a neutral Auction House, bank, inn, a boat to Ratchet, and unique recipe/item vendors. The weekly Stranglethorn Fishing Extravaganza event happens every Sunday from 2-4pm.

[[Booty Bay]], located to the southwest, is a major city run by [[goblin]] [[pirate]]s - many profession trainers are located here, as well as a neutral [[Auction House]], [[bank]], [[inn]], a boat to [[Ratchet]], and unique recipe/item vendors. The weekly [[Stranglethorn Fishing Extravaganza]] event happens every Sunday from 2-4pm. ==Description== {{main|Stranglethorn Vale}} The Cape of Stranglethorn is the southern part of [[Stranglethorn Vale]], split from the north by the [[Sundering (Stranglethorn Vale)|Sundering]] whirlpool caused by the [[Cataclysm (event)|Cataclysm]]. It traces the escalating conflict between the [[Blackwater Raiders|goblin pirates]] of [[Booty Bay]] and their rivals, the [[Bloodsail Buccaneers]]. The rest of the zone is dotted with [[troll]] ruins and sandy beaches. ==History== {{main|Stranglethorn Vale}} ==Geography== ===Maps and subregions=== [[File:WorldMap-TheCapeofStranglethorn.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Map of the Cape of Stranglethorn.]] {| class="darktable hlist" |- | *[[Bloodsail Compound]] *[[Booty Bay]] **[[Old Port Authority|The Old Port Authority]] **[[Salty Sailor Tavern|The Salty Sailor Tavern]] *[[Crystal Shore|The Crystal Shore]] *[[Crystalvein Mine]] *[[Explorers' League Digsite]] *[[Gurubashi Arena]] **[[Battle Ring]] *[[Hardwrench Hideaway]] *[[Jaguero Isle]] *[[Janeiro's Point]] *[[Mistvale Valley]] **[[Spirit Den]] *[[Nek'mani Wellspring]] *[[Ruins of Aboraz]] *[[Ruins of Jubuwal]] *[[South Seas]] *[[Southern Savage Coast]] *[[Sundering (Stranglethorn Vale)|The Sundering]] *[[Wild Shore]] **''[[The Crimson Veil]]'' **''[[The Damsel's Luck]]'' **''[[The Riptide]]'' |- || ---- ;{{RPG-inline}} [[Warcraft RPG]] *[[Savage Hills]] |} {{clear|left}} ===Travel hubs=== ====={{Alliance}} [[Flight path]]s from [[Explorers' League Digsite]]===== * [[Fort Livingston]], [[Northern Stranglethorn]] * [[Booty Bay]], Cape of Stranglethorn ====={{Horde}} [[Flight path]]s from [[Hardwrench Hideaway]]===== * [[Grom'Gol]], [[Northern Stranglethorn]] * [[Booty Bay]], Cape of Stranglethorn ====={{Neutral}} [[Flight path]]s from [[Booty Bay]]===== * {{Alliance}} [[Stormwind]], [[Elwynn Forest]] * {{Alliance}} [[Sentinel Hill]], [[Westfall]] * {{Alliance}} [[Darkshire]], [[Duskwood]] * {{Alliance}} [[Rebel Camp]], [[Northern Stranglethorn]] * {{Horde}} [[Grom'Gol]], [[Northern Stranglethorn]] * {{Alliance}} [[Explorers' League Digsite]], Cape of Stranglethorn * {{Horde}} [[Hardwrench Hideaway]], Cape of Stranglethorn * {{Horde}} [[New Kargath]], [[Badlands]] * {{Horde}} [[Stonard]], [[Swamp of Sorrows]] * {{Horde}} [[Sunveil Excursion]], [[Blasted Lands]] * {{Alliance}} [[Surwich]], [[Blasted Lands]] ===Adjacent regions=== {| class="darktable" |- ! In [[Booty Bay]], [[Baron Revilgaz]] and [[Fleet Master Seahorn]] seek aid in the battle against the Bloodsail Buccaneers. In [[Grom'gol Base Camp]], [[Kin'weelay]] attempts to rid the jungle of the bloodthirsty Bloodscalp and Skullsplitter trolls. ==Quests== {{main|The Cape of Stranglethorn quests}} ==Player vs. player== The [[Gurubashi Arena]] is an arena that has a treasure chest placed at the center every 3 hours.
